regions.name: Rectus femoris
regions.description: Crosses both hip and knee, contributing to hip flexion as well as knee extension.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions: Align the machine axis with your knee. Extend your legs through a comfortable range and lower gradually.
exercises.cue: Use controlled movement without kicking or bouncing.
exercises.alsoWorks: Vastus lateralis, vastus medialis, vastus intermedius

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the bar in a secure front rack. Sit down between your hips while keeping the torso braced. Drive through the feet to stand.
exercises.cue: Keep your elbows lifted and knees tracking with your toes.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other quadriceps, gluteus maximus, adductors; trunk stabilizers

regions.name: Vastus lateralis
regions.description: The large outer-thigh muscle contributes to knee extension.
regions.note: These movements train the quadriceps together.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the bar in a secure front rack. Sit down between your hips while keeping the torso braced. Drive through the feet to stand.
exercises.cue: Keep your elbows lifted and knees tracking with your toes.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other quadriceps, gluteus maximus, adductors; trunk stabilizers

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions: Align the machine axis with your knee. Extend your legs through a comfortable range and lower gradually.
exercises.cue: Use controlled movement without kicking or bouncing.
exercises.alsoWorks: Rectus femoris, vastus medialis, vastus intermedius

regions.name: Vastus medialis
regions.description: The inner portion contributes to knee extension and patellar control.
regions.note: No special foot position isolates this region.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.instructions: Rest your rear foot on a low bench. Lower through the front leg, then press back up.
exercises.cue: Choose a stance that lets the front foot stay planted.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other quadriceps, gluteus maximus, adductors; gluteus medius stabilizes

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions: Align the machine axis with your knee. Extend your legs through a comfortable range and lower gradually.
exercises.cue: Use controlled movement without kicking or bouncing.
exercises.alsoWorks: Rectus femoris, vastus lateralis, vastus intermedius

regions.name: Vastus intermedius
regions.description: A deeper knee extensor beneath rectus femoris.
regions.note: This deep muscle works with the other knee extensors.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions: Align the machine axis with your knee. Extend your legs through a comfortable range and lower gradually.
exercises.cue: Use controlled movement without kicking or bouncing.
exercises.alsoWorks: Rectus femoris, vastus lateralis, vastus medialis

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the bar in a secure front rack. Sit down between your hips while keeping the torso braced. Drive through the feet to stand.
exercises.cue: Keep your elbows lifted and knees tracking with your toes.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other quadriceps, gluteus maximus, adductors; trunk stabilizers

regions.name: Biceps femoris
regions.description: The lateral hamstring has a long and short head. Both flex the knee; the long head also extends the hip.
regions.note: Hip hinges load the long head; leg curls also involve the short head.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: With soft knees, push your hips back and keep the bar near your legs. Stop when you reach your controlled hinge depth, then stand.
exercises.cue: Move at the hips while maintaining a steady back position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Semitendinosus, semimembranosus, gluteus maximus; spinal extensors stabilize

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.instructions: Adjust the pads to secure your thighs. Bend your knees to pull the pad down and back. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips on the seat through the entire rep.

regions.name: Semitendinosus
regions.description: A medial hamstring that extends the hip and bends the knee.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: With soft knees, push your hips back and keep the bar near your legs. Stop when you reach your controlled hinge depth, then stand.
exercises.cue: Move at the hips while maintaining a steady back position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Biceps femoris long head, semimembranosus, gluteus maximus; spinal extensors stabilize

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.instructions: Adjust the pads to secure your thighs. Bend your knees to pull the pad down and back. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips on the seat through the entire rep.

regions.name: Semimembranosus
regions.description: A deeper medial hamstring with similar hip and knee functions.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.instructions: Adjust the pads to secure your thighs. Bend your knees to pull the pad down and back. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips on the seat through the entire rep.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: With soft knees, push your hips back and keep the bar near your legs. Stop when you reach your controlled hinge depth, then stand.
exercises.cue: Move at the hips while maintaining a steady back position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Biceps femoris long head, semitendinosus, gluteus maximus; spinal extensors stabilize

regions.name: Gluteus maximus
regions.description: The largest gluteal muscle produces strong hip extension and contributes to external rotation.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Support your upper back on a stable bench with the padded bar across your hips. Drive through your feet to extend your hips.
exercises.cue: Finish with your ribs down rather than arching the lower back.
exercises.alsoWorks: Hamstrings, adductor magnus; abdominal wall stabilizes

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.instructions: Place one foot fully on a stable step. Drive through that leg to stand tall, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your pelvis level and limit push-off from the trailing foot.

regions.name: Gluteus medius
regions.description: Helps move the leg outward and stabilize the pelvis while standing on one leg.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with the upper leg straight. Lift it slightly, then lower without rolling your hips.
exercises.cue: Keep your toes facing forward and the pelvis stacked.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.instructions: Place a light band above your knees. With a shallow knee bend, step sideways while maintaining tension and keeping the pelvis level.
exercises.cue: Keep knees tracking with your feet; avoid swaying your torso.
exercises.alsoWorks: Gluteus minimus, tensor fasciae latae; quadriceps support the stance

regions.name: Gluteus minimus
regions.description: A deeper muscle beneath the medius that assists hip abduction and pelvic control.
regions.note: Hip abduction loads the minimus together with the other hip abductors.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with the upper leg straight. Lift it slightly, then lower without rolling your hips.
exercises.cue: Keep your toes facing forward and the pelvis stacked.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.instructions: Place a light band above your knees. With a shallow knee bend, step sideways while maintaining tension and keeping the pelvis level.
exercises.cue: Keep knees tracking with your feet; avoid swaying your torso.
exercises.alsoWorks: Gluteus medius, tensor fasciae latae; quadriceps support the stance

regions.name: Adductor longus
regions.description: Superficial inner-thigh muscle that adducts the hip.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip adduction
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with the top leg crossed in front for support. Lift the straight lower leg a short distance, then lower.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis steady and the lower knee facing forward.

regions.name: Adductor brevis
regions.description: A shorter, deeper adductor beneath adductor longus.

exercises.name: Ball adductor squeeze
exercises.instructions: Lie with knees bent and a soft ball between them. Squeeze gently, then release fully.
exercises.cue: Keep breathing; avoid forceful squeezing or holding your breath.
exercises.alsoWorks: Adductor longus and magnus, gracilis, pectineus

regions.name: Adductor magnus
regions.description: Large medial-thigh muscle with adductor fibers and a hip-extending hamstring portion.
regions.note: Hip hinges involve the hip-extending portion; adduction exercises load the adductor portion.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip adduction
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with the top leg crossed in front for support. Lift the straight lower leg a short distance, then lower.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis steady and the lower knee facing forward.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: With soft knees, push your hips back and keep the bar near your legs. Stop when you reach your controlled hinge depth, then stand.
exercises.cue: Move at the hips while maintaining a steady back position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Hamstrings, gluteus maximus; spinal extensors stabilize

regions.name: Gracilis
regions.description: Crosses the hip and knee, contributing to hip adduction and knee flexion.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip adduction
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with the top leg crossed in front for support. Lift the straight lower leg a short distance, then lower.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis steady and the lower knee facing forward.

regions.name: Pectineus
regions.description: A short upper-inner-thigh muscle assisting hip adduction and flexion.

exercises.name: Ball adductor squeeze
exercises.instructions: Lie with knees bent and a soft ball between them. Squeeze gently, then release fully.
exercises.cue: Keep breathing; avoid forceful squeezing or holding your breath.

exercises.name: Standing resisted march
exercises.instructions: With support for balance and a light band at your foot, lift one knee toward hip height. Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your pelvis level and avoid leaning backward.

regions.name: Psoas major
regions.description: Runs from the lumbar spine to the upper femur and contributes to hip flexion.

exercises.name: Standing resisted march
exercises.instructions: With support for balance and a light band at your foot, lift one knee toward hip height. Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your pelvis level and avoid leaning backward.
exercises.alsoWorks: Iliacus, rectus femoris, sartorius, tensor fasciae latae

regions.name: Iliacus
regions.description: Fills the inner pelvis and joins psoas major to form the iliopsoas.

exercises.name: Standing resisted march
exercises.instructions: With support for balance and a light band at your foot, lift one knee toward hip height. Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your pelvis level and avoid leaning backward.

regions.name: Tensor fasciae latae
regions.description: Assists hip flexion, abduction, and internal rotation.

exercises.name: Standing resisted march
exercises.instructions: With support for balance and a light band at your foot, lift one knee toward hip height. Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your pelvis level and avoid leaning backward.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.instructions: Place a light band above your knees. With a shallow knee bend, step sideways while maintaining tension and keeping the pelvis level.
exercises.cue: Keep knees tracking with your feet; avoid swaying your torso.
exercises.alsoWorks: Gluteus medius, gluteus minimus; quadriceps support the stance

regions.name: Sartorius
regions.description: A long strap muscle that assists hip flexion, abduction, and external rotation, and bends the knee.
regions.note: The march loads hip flexion; it does not isolate all of sartorius’s actions.

exercises.name: Standing resisted march
exercises.instructions: With support for balance and a light band at your foot, lift one knee toward hip height. Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep your pelvis level and avoid leaning backward.
exercises.alsoWorks: Iliopsoas, rectus femoris, tensor fasciae latae

regions.name: Piriformis
regions.description: Runs from the sacrum to the upper femur. Its contribution changes with hip angle.
regions.note: Use a comfortable range; this is shared rotational loading rather than isolation.

exercises.name: Seated band hip external rotation
exercises.instructions: Sit with a bent knee supported. Against light resistance, rotate the thigh outward so the foot moves inward. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis still. Hip position changes which rotators contribute.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other deep hip rotators, gluteus maximus

regions.name: Obturator internus
regions.description: Deep pelvic muscle that joins the short external rotators at the femur.

exercises.name: Seated band hip external rotation
exercises.instructions: Sit with a bent knee supported. Against light resistance, rotate the thigh outward so the foot moves inward. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis still. Hip position changes which rotators contribute.
exercises.alsoWorks: Gemelli, obturator externus, quadratus femoris, gluteus maximus

regions.name: Obturator externus
regions.description: Deep external rotator on the outside of the obturator membrane.

exercises.name: Seated band hip external rotation
exercises.instructions: Sit with a bent knee supported. Against light resistance, rotate the thigh outward so the foot moves inward. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis still. Hip position changes which rotators contribute.

regions.name: Superior gemellus
regions.description: Small muscle above the obturator internus tendon, assisting external rotation.

exercises.name: Seated band hip external rotation
exercises.instructions: Sit with a bent knee supported. Against light resistance, rotate the thigh outward so the foot moves inward. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis still. Hip position changes which rotators contribute.
exercises.alsoWorks: Obturator internus, inferior gemellus, other external rotators

regions.name: Inferior gemellus
regions.description: Small muscle below the obturator internus tendon, assisting external rotation.

exercises.name: Seated band hip external rotation
exercises.instructions: Sit with a bent knee supported. Against light resistance, rotate the thigh outward so the foot moves inward. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis still. Hip position changes which rotators contribute.
exercises.alsoWorks: Obturator internus, superior gemellus, other external rotators

regions.name: Quadratus femoris
regions.description: A short, flat external rotator that also assists hip adduction.

exercises.name: Seated band hip external rotation
exercises.instructions: Sit with a bent knee supported. Against light resistance, rotate the thigh outward so the foot moves inward. Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the pelvis still. Hip position changes which rotators contribute.

regions.name: Gastrocnemius
regions.description: The prominent two-headed calf muscle crosses the knee and ankle. Straight-knee calf raises load it alongside the soleus.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet with knees softly extended. Pause, then lower the heels slowly.
exercises.cue: Use a full comfortable range without bouncing.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.instructions: Hold a support for balance. Lift and lower the heel of one leg with control.
exercises.cue: Keep the ankle aligned rather than rolling outward.

regions.name: Soleus
regions.description: Lies beneath the gastrocnemius and acts at the ankle. Bent-knee raises reduce the gastrocnemius contribution.
regions.note: A bent knee reduces the gastrocnemius contribution, emphasizing the soleus.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.instructions: With knees bent around 90°, lift your heels against the resistance. Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep pressure through the forefoot and control the bottom position.
exercises.alsoWorks: Gastrocnemius contributes less with the knee bent; foot stabilizers

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet with knees softly extended. Pause, then lower the heels slowly.
exercises.cue: Use a full comfortable range without bouncing.

regions.name: Tibialis anterior
regions.description: Lifts the front of the foot and turns the sole inward.

exercises.name: Supported toe raise
exercises.instructions: Stand with your back supported and heels on the floor. Lift the fronts of your feet, pause briefly, then lower.
exercises.cue: Lift through the ankle without rocking your body.

exercises.name: Band ankle inversion
exercises.instructions: Sit with your leg supported. Against a light band, turn the sole inward through a small range, then return.
exercises.cue: Move at the ankle; keep the knee and hip still.

regions.name: Tibialis posterior
regions.description: Deep calf muscle that inverts the foot, assists plantar flexion, and supports the arch.

exercises.name: Band ankle inversion
exercises.instructions: Sit with your leg supported. Against a light band, turn the sole inward through a small range, then return.
exercises.cue: Move at the ankle; keep the knee and hip still.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.instructions: Hold a support for balance. Lift and lower the heel of one leg with control.
exercises.cue: Keep the ankle aligned rather than rolling outward.

regions.name: Fibularis longus & brevis
regions.description: Lateral-leg muscles that turn the sole outward and assist plantar flexion.

exercises.name: Band ankle eversion
exercises.instructions: Sit with your leg supported. Turn the sole outward against a light band, then return slowly.
exercises.cue: Avoid rotating your whole leg.

regions.name: Extensor digitorum longus
regions.description: Extends the smaller toes and assists ankle dorsiflexion.

exercises.name: Toe extension against light resistance
exercises.instructions: With the foot supported, lift the toes against a very light band, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the ankle still to emphasize the toe movement.
exercises.alsoWorks: Extensor hallucis longus and short toe extensors

exercises.name: Supported toe raise
exercises.instructions: Stand with your back supported and heels on the floor. Lift the fronts of your feet, pause briefly, then lower.
exercises.cue: Lift through the ankle without rocking your body.

regions.name: Extensor hallucis longus
regions.description: Extends the big toe and assists ankle dorsiflexion.

exercises.name: Toe extension against light resistance
exercises.instructions: With the foot supported, lift the toes against a very light band, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the ankle still to emphasize the toe movement.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other toe extensors; tibialis anterior stabilizes

regions.name: Flexor digitorum longus
regions.description: Deep posterior-leg muscle that bends the smaller toes and helps support the foot.

exercises.name: Towel toe curl
exercises.instructions: Sit with your heel on the floor and toes on a towel. Draw the towel toward you with the toes, then release.
exercises.cue: Keep the ankle relaxed and use smooth, small movements.
exercises.alsoWorks: Flexor digitorum brevis, quadratus plantae, intrinsic foot muscles

regions.name: Flexor hallucis longus
regions.description: Deep posterior-leg muscle that bends the big toe and contributes to push-off.

exercises.name: Big-toe press
exercises.instructions: Keep the heel and ball of the foot grounded. Gently press the big toe into the floor, then relax.
exercises.cue: Keep the arch steady without gripping with the other toes.
exercises.alsoWorks: Flexor hallucis brevis, other intrinsic foot muscles

regions.name: Abductor hallucis
regions.description: Runs along the inner foot and moves the big toe away from the second toe.

exercises.name: Short-foot hold
exercises.instructions: Keep your toes long and gently draw the ball of the foot toward the heel to raise the arch. Relax fully.
exercises.cue: Avoid curling the toes or rolling to the outside edge.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other intrinsic foot muscles, tibialis posterior

exercises.name: Toe spread
exercises.instructions: With the foot resting on the floor, spread the toes gently, pause, then relax.
exercises.cue: Keep the heel grounded and avoid forcing individual toes.

regions.name: Flexor hallucis brevis
regions.description: Short plantar muscle that bends the big toe at its base.

exercises.name: Big-toe press
exercises.instructions: Keep the heel and ball of the foot grounded. Gently press the big toe into the floor, then relax.
exercises.cue: Keep the arch steady without gripping with the other toes.

regions.name: Adductor hallucis
regions.description: Draws the big toe toward the other toes and contributes to forefoot stability.

exercises.name: Toe adduction squeeze
exercises.instructions: Place a small piece of soft foam between adjacent toes. Bring the toes together gently and release.
exercises.cue: Keep the rest of the foot relaxed.

exercises.name: Short-foot hold
exercises.instructions: Keep your toes long and gently draw the ball of the foot toward the heel to raise the arch. Relax fully.
exercises.cue: Avoid curling the toes or rolling to the outside edge.
exercises.alsoWorks: Other intrinsic foot muscles, tibialis posterior

regions.name: Flexor digitorum brevis
regions.description: Short sole muscle that bends the smaller toes.

exercises.name: Towel toe curl
exercises.instructions: Sit with your heel on the floor and toes on a towel. Draw the towel toward you with the toes, then release.
exercises.cue: Keep the ankle relaxed and use smooth, small movements.
exercises.alsoWorks: Flexor digitorum longus, quadratus plantae, lumbricals

regions.name: Quadratus plantae
regions.description: Assists the long toe flexor in bending the smaller toes.

exercises.name: Towel toe curl
exercises.instructions: Sit with your heel on the floor and toes on a towel. Draw the towel toward you with the toes, then release.
exercises.cue: Keep the ankle relaxed and use smooth, small movements.

regions.name: Foot interossei & lumbricals
regions.description: Coordinate toe spacing and the balance of toe-joint flexion and extension.

exercises.name: Toe spread
exercises.instructions: With the foot resting on the floor, spread the toes gently, pause, then relax.
exercises.cue: Keep the heel grounded and avoid forcing individual toes.

exercises.name: Toe adduction squeeze
exercises.instructions: Place a small piece of soft foam between adjacent toes. Bring the toes together gently and release.
exercises.cue: Keep the rest of the foot relaxed.

regions.name: Abductor digiti minimi
regions.description: Runs along the outer foot and helps move the little toe outward.

exercises.name: Toe spread
exercises.instructions: With the foot resting on the floor, spread the toes gently, pause, then relax.
exercises.cue: Keep the heel grounded and avoid forcing individual toes.

exercises.name: Short-foot hold
exercises.instructions: Keep your toes long and gently draw the ball of the foot toward the heel to raise the arch. Relax fully.
exercises.cue: Avoid curling the toes or rolling to the outside edge.

regions.name: Extensor digitorum & hallucis brevis
regions.description: Short muscles on the top of the foot that assist toe extension.

exercises.name: Toe extension against light resistance
exercises.instructions: With the foot supported, lift the toes against a very light band, then lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Keep the ankle still to emphasize the toe movement.
